messages:
Mel: seeing GSLB alerts — geo weight oscillation between eu-west and na-west for model-large, backpressure on na-west causing quick spill to ap-southeast. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/board/xyz :rotating_light:
Jordan: on it, what's the error? any logs or recent deploys?
Mel: LB logs show 503 spike on na-west pool and connqueue >1200, GSLB health flapping. GPU pool utilization on na-west 98% with OOM retries for model-large. quick snapshot:
```
na-west: gpu_util=98%, queue=1300, 5xx=420/min
eu-west: gpu_util=62%, queue=120, 5xx=12/min
ap-southeast: gpu_util=85%, queue=700, tlp=high
```
Priya: I'd prefer shift out of na-west into eu-west for steadier latency for EU traffic. AP users will be affected if we shove too much into ap-southeast.
Sasha: FYI current GSLB policy = "latency_preference + soft_evacuate" with max_delta=0.35 and stabilization-window=10s — that low window is probably causing the oscillation.
Mel: propose a controlled quiet-ramp: reduce na-west weight by ~20% in 5 increments over 15m, bump stabilization-window to 60s to damp oscillation, and enable a fallback for burst traffic to model-medium.
Jordan: agree. preparing command — will apply ramp + stabilization.
Jordan: command ready:
```
# set ramp policy (safe ramp, stabilize to avoid flip-flopping)
gslb-cli set-policy --service=inference --region=global --stabilization-window=60 --max-weight-delta=0.2 --ramp-steps=5
```
Jordan: applying now, watching health and 5xx.
deploy-bot: deploy started by Jordan at 2025-10-11T14:05:12Z
Priya: small perf tweak: reduce kv-cache TTL in eu-west to 30s to reduce cold-starts there (tradeoff: slightly staler cache). happy to apply if we decide eu absorbs more load.
Sasha: made the kv-cache TTL change in eu-west via platform API, propagation looks immediate.
Jordan: policy applied. starting ramp: na-west weight 0.55 -> target 0.35 over 5 steps (approx -4% per step).
Mel: observing after step1: na GPU utilization dropped to ~86%, 5xx down ~40% — good so far :thumbsup:
Infra Oncall: adding a short-lived ingress throttle on ap-southeast to cap per-customer QPS to 120 to limit hot-spotting while ramp completes.
Jordan: throttle rule in place (rate-limit id rl-apse-001).
Mel: note for finance: moving more traffic EU <-> AP may increase cross-region egress by ~2.3TB/hr, rough estimate. @finance heads-up.
Priya: also enabling model fallback mapping for 10% of requests during the peak to model-medium to reduce OOMs. rollout command:
```
platform-cli rollout --service=inference --model-fallback="model-large:model-medium=0.1"
```
deploy-bot: rollout queued (id r-20251011-14-08)
Mel: keep stabilization-window=60s for at least 30m after ramp completes. if we still see oscillation, escalate to manual region split and per-geo pinning.
Jordan: trend looks stable at 10m in. na-west util ~79%, eu-west up to ~74% but tail latency acceptable. continuing to monitor for 30m. will update in 15.
Mel: thanks — keeping thread open but will close if no further alerts.
Jordan: noted, will post if anything regresses.
